environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client authentication). Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The container has unrestricted outbound network access and can reach the EC2 instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254. DNS resolution is handled by the default VPC resolver with no response policy zones configured.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS:443 listener, ACM certificate, no mutual TLS
config.network: VPC with default DNS resolver, no egress filtering, IMDS v1 enabled on task role
config.security_groups: inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, outbound all traffic allowed
config.iam: Task role with ssm:GetParameter and s3:GetObject permissions
